logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.

moments.description: Catherine enters the dark damp dungeon holding a red-hot iron and a charred book, towering over the chained and shivering Juliana.
Juliana fires back at Catherine with fierce defiance, prompting Catherine to mock her public humiliation at the altar.
moments.key_dialogue: I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.

moments.description: Juliana stands her ground with profound dignity, refusing to be shamed by her failed marriage or Catherine's taunts.
Juliana pierces through Catherine's aristocratic facade by exposing her deep insecurity and desperation for submission.
moments.key_dialogue: If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.

moments.description: Catherine viciously presses the red-hot iron into the pages of Juliana's late mother's botanical book, breaking Juliana's composure.
moments.key_dialogue: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.

moments.description: Catherine slowly burns her mother's life's work to ash and suddenly swings the searing hot poker inches from Juliana's face.
moments.key_dialogue: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.
